blocks.x: The contract behind Smart Cities & Infrastructure: signed baseline in week two, working slice by week eight, industrialized controls by week twelve, and evidence flowing to your control owner throughout.

The operating context for Smart Cities & Infrastructure is set by your regulatory reality, your decision pressure and the estate you actually run — the design starts from those three, not from a reference model.

blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Smart Cities & Infrastructure
blocks.note: Contracts between stages are enforced at the boundary, so schema drift fails loudly in minutes instead of quietly in a quarter.

blocks.x: The architecture for Smart Cities & Infrastructure is deliberately auditable: every stage exposes its inputs, its owner and its failure policy, and the decision path shares a timeline with the audit path. Nothing important happens off the record.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Silent schema drift
Contracts enforced at the boundary — schema drift fails the pipeline loudly, in minutes.
Cost creep
Unit costs on a published budget with alerts at the threshold — creep is caught by the meter, not by the invoice.
Metric anarchy
One definition per metric, owned and versioned — the dashboard and the board pack cannot disagree.
